whenToUse: Mobile lists people tidy often, such as email or tasks.
There's no room to show a delete button on every row.
whenNotToUse: Mouse-driven desktop tables (use a button at the end of the row, or select and delete in bulk).
A row contains content that scrolls sideways.

alternatives.name: Undo
alternatives.reason: Offering a chance to take it back right after deleting.

accessibility: The delete button is a real button, so tabbing to it slides the row and reveals it, allowing deletion without the gesture.
Put the item name in the button name (Delete meeting notes cleanup) so screen reader users know what's being deleted.
Announce the result and undo with role=status.
touch-action: pan-y leaves vertical scrolling untouched.
